AC-01.evidence: 2350 reviewed canonical identities and 4698 valid paired provider xG observations.

AC-02.evidence: 140 reviewed SH/SOT pairs and no same-fixture Sportmonks pairs. No speculative normalization.

AC-03.evidence: Deterministic, separate B1 and B2 selections include every in-scope candidate.

AC-04.evidence: Trusted frozen LR and strict-before feature construction. Target-label mutation regression passes.

AC-05.evidence: Cohort metrics and matched baseline preserve label, side, pairing and full denominators.

AC-06.evidence: Provider-specific labels and historical-vintage limitations bound retrospective conclusions.

AC-07.evidence: Protected manifests and snapshot hashes match. The replay uses the existing fitted artifact offline.

AC-08.evidence: Targeted and full offline tests pass. Aggregate evidence and backend handoff are published in this branch.

assumptions.feature_comparison: Same feature schema by role across B1/B2, confounded by roster, period and selection
assumptions.residual: clipped LR xG minus provider-reported xG
assumptions.vintage: No proof of historical as-of-vintage availability

backend_handoff.blocked_status: Expose existing readiness or blocked statuses when history or verified statistics are insufficient.
backend_handoff.metric_labelling: Expose provider-specific retrospective metrics with separate cohort denominators and visible limitations.
backend_handoff.publication: Return permitted aggregate or demo fields. Keep private records, source CSVs and SQLite snapshots in ignored local storage.

shots.scope: Descriptive paired counts in the reviewed 2025 shot-event overlap

limitations: The frozen snapshot cannot establish historical as-of-vintage availability or independently verified prospective performance.
Provider-labelled errors depend on verified completion, observed target coverage and representable history.
Source, calendar period, team roster and selection are confounded in between-cohort feature comparisons.
The fixture bootstrap preserves home and away pairing but does not model shared-team or temporal dependence.
scientific_assessment.predictive_evidence: Retrospective date-cutoff replay. On each scored provider-labelled subset, LR MAE is below the same-row rolling baseline and mean residual is negative.
scientific_assessment.statistical_evidence: Matched FBref and Understat xG differ by provider, season and perspective. Reviewed SH/SOT overlap is limited to 70 fixtures and does not cover Sportmonks.
scientific_assessment.structural_compatibility: Frozen 13-feature input accepted on the eligible B1 and B2 fixtures. The existing builder enforced coverage and actual last-five.
